intro: This map mirrors the SInC website skeleton. Each pillar is a section of the site — use it to know what content belongs where and what still needs real data.

pillars.title: Startup Portfolio
pillars.summary: Showcase every venture SInC supports — who built it, what they're building, and where they are today.
pillars.editNote: Add one object per startup. Logo goes in public/ and path in logo field.

pillars.title: Master Calendar
pillars.summary: One place for everything time-based — recurring founder meets, funding, networking, scheme deadlines, and cohort-only milestones.
includes: Government scheme deadlines (DPIIT, Startup India, BIRAC, NIDHI-EIR)
pillars.editNote: Use category + cohortOnly + recurring fields. Month picker reads dates automatically.

pillars.title: Network & Resources
pillars.summary: Show off connections — alumni, investors, industrial experts, visits — plus open guides for founders.
pillars.editNote: Replace placeholder names with real mentors and partners when cleared.

pillars.title: Cohort 01
pillars.summary: The Hacker House / Venture Lab — bold IIT Delhi founder story for students and investors. Rules, plan, what founders get.
includes: Benefits: ₹43k build budget, ₹20k fellowship, SAFE funding
pillars.editNote: Fill track titles/descriptions when tracks report is published.

pillars.title: Opportunities
pillars.summary: Team matching for co-builders and a bounty board for students who want to ship tasks for startups.
includes: Student skill tags & screening before contact
Bounties: task, reward (money or treat), deadline
pillars.editNote: Phase 2: backend for applications. For now, static listings + contact.

pillars.title: Join & Connect
pillars.summary: How to join SInC as a founder, and clear paths for alumni, investors, and industry partners.
